verdict.rationale: Abandoned-cart recovery is a fair question to ask of an ecommerce platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions abandoned cart or checkout recovery emails or links. Webhooks, the Checkout SDK and the REST APIs are developer building blocks, not the recovery capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant, abandoned carts and checkouts trigger recovery emails or links so I can win the sale back
